_doc: Knowledge categories per exam level — the ONE list build_knowledge.py and check_knowledge.py read (jlpt-knowledge/SKILL.md §Categories). `stem`: the data name under knowledge/<LEVEL>/ (a file <stem>.json or a folder <stem>/ of parts). `kind`: item|guide. `label`/`desc`: keys in languages/<code>/knowledge.json. item kind only: `headword` and `reading` name the shared fields a card prints as its title (reading may be null), `facts` the further shared fields printed under it (label key field_<name>), `fields` the type of every one of them (str|list), `prose_optional` the language-file fields that may be "", `pitch` whether headword pitch lines are looked up in the dataset (an entry's own `pitch` field is always honoured). `examples`/`quiz`: [min, max] per entry. `quiz_gen` (item kind): the quiz types the BUILDER generates per entry from the data (scripts/quiz_gen.py: `reading` -> `<id>#r`, `meaning` -> `<id>#m`); `quiz` then bounds only the hand-authored items beside them. A level with an empty list has no knowledge module yet (the portal shows it as coming). `order` (every category; jlpt-knowledge SKILL §Book order): the ONE order every page lists its cards in — no page may reorder them. "book": each entry's shared `book` field [section, lesson, item(, split)]; `book_sections` names each section and the `group` label it implies ({n} = lesson, {L} = lesson as IV letter A–G); `book_splits` lists every "section-lesson-item" that two or more entries share by meaning (each then carries a distinct 4th element). "id": the key is read off the id — `order_series` in order, each a regex matched against the id (a capture group = the book number, sorted numerically; no capture = unnumbered: grouped under their `group` label, groups in the order of their first numbered entry, then by `reading` in gojūon order) or "inventory" (ids the level's references/inventory/<LEVEL>.json lists for the category, in its order).

book_splits.1-26-2: 〜ものだ 26課2: 回想 (A) / 感慨 (B) — the book's own A/B
book_splits.2-4-29: IV-D 伝聞 line: 〜ということだ / 〜とのことだ
book_splits.2-5-10: IV-E line: 〜ところから / 〜ことから
book_splits.9-0-65: SK外 〜そうだ: 様態 / 伝聞 — two meanings the exam keys separately (7/2018-43 伝聞, 12/2020 問題7-40 様態)
